brief.summary_1line: Lakshmana insists on accompanying Rama into exile, arguing devotion and service despite Rama urging him to stay and care for their mothers.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana stands before Rama with folded hands and tearful eyes, vowing to follow him into the forest with bow and arrows.
Sita distributes her jewels and rich garments to gathered brahmins and the poor before leaving for exile.
Lakshmana promises to walk ahead through the forest carrying bow, arrows, spade, and basket while Rama and Sita follow among trees and deer.
